# IELTS Liz

> > Free IELTS preparation platform offering comprehensive lessons, practice materials, and expert strategies across all four test modules.

IELTS Liz is a dedicated IELTS preparation resource created by Elizabeth Ferguson, providing free tips, lessons, and practice materials for both Academic and General Training test formats. The platform covers all four skills (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) with model answers, band score guidance, and exam strategies.

## Key Topics

- IELTS
- Listening
- Reading
- Writing Task 1
- Writing Task 2
- Speaking
- Academic IELTS
- General Training (GT)
- Band Scores
- Model Answers
- Vocabulary
- Exam Strategy
- Cambridge Test Books
- Free Lessons
- Question Types

## Core IELTS Skills

- [IELTS Listening FREE Practice, Tips & Techniques](https://ieltsliz.com/ielts-listening): Free IELTS Listening practice with techniques and band score guidance
- [IELTS Reading: FREE Practice, Tips & Techniques](https://ieltsliz.com/ielts-reading-lessons-information-and-tips): IELTS Reading lessons covering Academic, GT, question types and strategies
- [IELTS Writing Task 1 Tips, Model Answers & More](https://ieltsliz.com/ielts-writing-task-1-lessons-and-tips): Writing Task 1 guidance with model answers, band scores and chart techniques
- [IELTS Writing Task 2: Free Tips, Lessons & Model Essays](https://ieltsliz.com/ielts-writing-task-2): Writing Task 2 lessons with model essays, structure tips and practice questions
- [IELTS Speaking: Free Lessons & Essential Tips](https://ieltsliz.com/ielts-speaking-free-lessons-essential-tips): IELTS Speaking test guide with tips, model answers and topic preparation

## Practice & Study Materials

- [100 IELTS Essay Questions](https://ieltsliz.com/100-ielts-essay-questions): Collection of 100 IELTS Writing Task 2 essay questions for practice
- [Vocabulary for IELTS: Word Lists, Exercises & Pronunciation](https://ieltsliz.com/vocabulary): IELTS vocabulary lessons with word lists, pronunciation and paraphrasing tips
- [Recommended Book List for IELTS](https://ieltsliz.com/recommended-books-for-ielts): Curated reading list of Cambridge and study resources for IELTS prep

## Getting Started

- [IELTS Liz – IELTS Preparation with Liz: Free IELTS Tips and Lessons, 2026](https://ieltsliz.com): Homepage offering free IELTS preparation tips, lessons and exam strategies
